root.short: Workflow automation agent that runs on your machine (n8n alternative)
root.long:
Mono Agent — workflow automation that runs on your machine (n8n alternative) in a single Go binary. Build, schedule, and run DAG workflows (167 node types, including social platform actions for your own accounts — see docs/USAGE_POLICY.md) from CLI, GUI, or MCP.

START HERE — what can this already do?

  monoagentcli workflow search [query]      Everything runnable: bundled
                                            templates + saved workflows, each
                                            with the command that runs it
  monoagentcli workflow templates show <id> Inputs, nodes, and exact run command
  monoagentcli ref templates                Guide to the bundled templates

All state (workflows, logins, generated images) lives in ~/.monoagent/, so every
command works from any directory — there is nothing to set up per project. Add
--json to the discovery commands above for machine-readable output.

AI agents: run 'monoagentcli ref' for built-in, offline documentation
covering every command and workflow node type in depth — including
'monoagentcli ref connections' for the profile/OAuth/credential model
(read this before writing anything that touches --profile or
--credential) and 'monoagentcli ref examples' for common patterns. This
is the primary, most current source of truth for how the CLI is meant to
be used — prefer it over guessing from --help output alone.

The user's own task board (what to work on next, and how to report back): 'monoagentcli ref tasks'.

The account gate is dormant: local work needs no monoes.me sign-in and makes no implicit account requests. The online library needs a sign-in. See 'monoagentcli ref account' for the machine session and future gate behavior; no enforcement date is announced.
workflow.long:
Create, list, run, activate, deactivate, delete, and inspect executions of workflows.

For scheduled (trigger.schedule) or webhook (trigger.webhook) workflows to fire on their own over time, `monoagentcli daemon` must be running continuously — `workflow activate` alone only registers triggers for as long as that one command is running.
workflow.templates.short: Browse and instantiate bundled ready-to-use workflow templates
workflow.search.short: Search bundled templates and saved workflows by name, description, or node type
workflow.search.long:
Search everything runnable — bundled templates and the workflows saved for this profile — by name, description, or the node types involved. Omit the query to list everything.

Each hit comes with the command that runs it.
node.short: Directly invoke or inspect workflow node types
node.schema.short: Print the embedded JSON schema for a node type
node.schema.example:
monoagentcli node schema core.if
  monoagentcli node schema trigger.schedule
connect.short: Connect a platform via API key, OAuth, or other methods
connect.long: Authenticate to a platform and save the connection. Run `monoagentcli connect list --all` to see all supported platforms.
connect.example:
monoagentcli connect github
  monoagentcli connect notion
  monoagentcli connect list
  monoagentcli connect list --all
  monoagentcli connect test <id>
  monoagentcli connect remove <id>
  monoagentcli connect refresh <id>
schedule.long: List, add, and remove schedules for actions.
